bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first personal life and work operating system
bundle.longDescription: Mehr Life OS is a bilingual (Persian/English), offline-first personal life and work operating system: tasks, education, projects, finance, nutrition, workouts, journaling, news radar and local backup — all stored on your own device.
